title: End-to-End Authority Composition & Failure Injection Evaluation
primarySecurityResult: The 2-of-3 threshold authority model composed across worker recovery, supervisor checkpointing, clean-room dual-gate verification, and offline replay deterministically enforces fail-closed evidence integrity under all single-point crashes, lease expirations, replay tamperings, and single-authority compromises.
primaryRemainingGap: Content-addressed evidence archiving indexes strictly on bundleId (SHA-256 of canonical bundle payload), leaving a logical execution identity gap where multiple structurally distinct bundles for the same runId can be archived without collision detection.

scenarios.title: Worker Crash Before Signature
scenarios.setup: Run executed and clean-room verified in SQLite store, but worker process crashes before invoking signer
scenarios.attackerCapability: Unsigned bundle emitted into ingestion pipeline
scenarios.expected: Quarantine unsigned bundle with UNSIGNED_BUNDLE_REJECTED; archive remains clean
scenarios.observed: Bundle quarantined with UNSIGNED_BUNDLE_REJECTED; hasAccepted returned false

scenarios.title: Worker Crash After Signature, Before Supervisor Endorsement
scenarios.setup: Worker signs bundle with WORKER_PRODUCER key; supervisor crashes before endorsing
scenarios.attackerCapability: 1-of-3 signed bundle submitted to 2-of-3 threshold gateway
scenarios.expected: Quarantine with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES; accept once recovered supervisor endorses
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES on 1-of-3; accepted upon supervisor co-signing (2-of-3)

scenarios.title: Worker Crash During Multi-Attempt Action
scenarios.setup: Attempt 1 marked UNKNOWN on crash; supervisor fences lease and dispatches Attempt 2
scenarios.attackerCapability: State store contains multi-attempt progression with UNKNOWN attempt
scenarios.expected: Evidence exporter packages complete attempt sequence; replay verifier validates attempt monotonicity
scenarios.observed: Exporter produced 2 attempts; replay verified attemptIntegrity and preserved UNKNOWN history

scenarios.title: Worker Split-Brain Two Workers Active Simultaneously
scenarios.setup: Stale worker holding expired lease attempts to write while active worker holds valid lease
scenarios.attackerCapability: Zombie worker write contention under Phase 31 lease fencing
scenarios.expected: Database rejects stale worker transition; only active lease worker persists actions
scenarios.observed: Stale worker action transition rejected with LeaseConflictError / FencingViolation; split-brain prevented

scenarios.title: Worker Lease Expiry Before Signing
scenarios.setup: Clock advanced 15s past worker lease TTL prior to run completion
scenarios.attackerCapability: Expired worker attempts coordinator.completeRun
scenarios.expected: Coordinator rejects completion attempt with lease expiration error
scenarios.observed: Operation threw LeaseExpiredError; invalid run completion prevented

scenarios.title: Supervisor Lease Expiry Before Endorsement
scenarios.setup: Supervisor claims lease, clock advanced 60s past supervisor lease TTL
scenarios.attackerCapability: Expired supervisor attempts coordinator.saveCheckpoint with supervisor fencing
scenarios.expected: Coordinator throws SupervisorLeaseExpiredError
scenarios.observed: saveCheckpoint threw SupervisorLeaseExpiredError; stale checkpoint rejected

scenarios.title: Supervisor Lease Lost During Endorsement
scenarios.setup: Supervisor lease explicitly expired in store during ongoing operations
scenarios.attackerCapability: Uncoordinated supervisor attempts to act without active lease
scenarios.expected: findActiveSupervisorLease returns null; supervisor operations fail closed
scenarios.observed: Active lease returned null; uncoordinated supervisor authority prevented

scenarios.title: Checkpoint Recovery + Threshold Evidence
scenarios.setup: Checkpoint version 1 persisted, run recovers to checkpoint version 2 with attempt monotonicity
scenarios.attackerCapability: Crash and resume from intermediate checkpoint state
scenarios.expected: Exported bundle includes both checkpoints; threshold signatures bind to final checkpointed state
scenarios.observed: Replay verified checkpointIntegrity; 2-of-3 threshold accepted recovered bundle

scenarios.title: Corrupted Checkpoint Rejection
scenarios.setup: Attacker mutates checkpointVersion from monotonic sequence (version set to 0)
scenarios.attackerCapability: Checkpoint sequence tampering inside signed bundle
scenarios.expected: Gateway quarantines bundle with REPLAY_VERIFICATION_FAILED; checkpointIntegrity false
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with REPLAY_VERIFICATION_FAILED; replay detected checkpoint version non-monotonic

scenarios.title: Divergent Contract Binding in Recovered Run
scenarios.setup: Attacker modifies checkpoint contractBinding.contentHash to point to rogue contract
scenarios.attackerCapability: Contract substitution in checkpoint history
scenarios.expected: Replay flags contract continuity failure; bundle quarantined
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with REPLAY_VERIFICATION_FAILED; replay detected contractBinding hash mismatch

scenarios.title: Clean-Room Verification Dual-Gate Rejection
scenarios.setup: Dual-gate verification result status tampered to REJECTED with exitCode 1
scenarios.attackerCapability: Verification failure presented alongside completion claim
scenarios.expected: Replay derives fourfold outcome verificationPassed: false; bundle quarantined
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with REPLAY_VERIFICATION_FAILED; fourfold outcome derived FAILED

scenarios.title: Dual-Gate Verification Witness Tampering
scenarios.setup: Attacker mutates verification evidence contentHash without altering evidenceId
scenarios.attackerCapability: Verification evidence artifact tampering
scenarios.expected: Gateway detects provenance/signature divergence; bundle quarantined
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with INVALID_SIGNATURE; cryptographic witness tamper detected

scenarios.title: Unverified Run False Completion
scenarios.setup: Run status set to COMPLETED while verificationResults array is completely emptied
scenarios.attackerCapability: Omission of verification proof from completed mission bundle
scenarios.expected: Replay rejects unverified completion claim; gateway quarantines bundle
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with REPLAY_VERIFICATION_FAILED; replay derived FAILED terminal outcome

scenarios.title: Duplicate Authority Identity Injection
scenarios.setup: Attacker supplies 2 signatures, but both are produced by the same WORKER_PRODUCER keyId
scenarios.attackerCapability: Sybil self-endorsement using duplicate authority signatures
scenarios.expected: Gateway rejects with DUPLICATE_AUTHORITY / INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES; counts only 1 distinct authority
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with DUPLICATE_AUTHORITY and INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES; distinctValidAuthorities: 1

scenarios.title: Single Authority Signatures Below Threshold
scenarios.setup: Bundle contains only 1 valid signature from SUPERVISOR under a 2-of-3 policy
scenarios.attackerCapability: Sub-threshold evidence submission
scenarios.expected: Gateway rejects with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES; distinctValidAuthorities: 1
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES; distinctValidAuthorities: 1

scenarios.title: All Three Authorities Sign
scenarios.setup: Bundle signed by all 3 authorities: WORKER_PRODUCER, SUPERVISOR, and INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER
scenarios.attackerCapability: Maximum unanimity endorsement (3-of-3 satisfied)
scenarios.expected: Gateway accepts bundle; distinctValidAuthorities: 3; archived immutably
scenarios.observed: Status ACCEPTED; distinctValidAuthorities: 3; stored in archive/accepted/

scenarios.title: Two Valid Authorities + One Corrupted Signature
scenarios.setup: Worker and Supervisor signatures are valid; Verifier signature corrupted with invalid hex
scenarios.attackerCapability: Corrupted non-critical signature alongside quorum
scenarios.expected: Gateway detects corrupt signature structure and quarantines for fail-closed hygiene
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with INVALID_SIGNATURE; invalid signature payload strictly rejected

scenarios.title: Revoked Authority During Endorsement
scenarios.setup: Supervisor key revoked in TrustedKeyring prior to gateway ingestion
scenarios.attackerCapability: Revoked authority signature submitted in 2-of-3 bundle
scenarios.expected: Gateway flags REVOKED_AUTHORITY; remaining 1 valid authority fails threshold
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with REVOKED_AUTHORITY and INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES; distinctValidAuthorities: 1

scenarios.title: Offline Replay of Valid Threshold Evidence
scenarios.setup: Bundle verified completely offline with zero network, zero model, zero SQLite access
scenarios.attackerCapability: Standalone air-gapped verification verification
scenarios.expected: Offline replay returns valid: true with all 4 integrity pillars established
scenarios.observed: Replay valid: true; contract, event, attempt, and authority integrity established

scenarios.title: Offline Replay of Rejected Evidence Explains Cause
scenarios.setup: Tampered bundle claiming COMPLETED but containing failed attempt (exitCode 1)
scenarios.attackerCapability: Fourfold outcome manipulation
scenarios.expected: Replay returns valid: false, terminalOutcome: FAILED, and details Fourfold outcome mismatch
scenarios.observed: Replay valid: false; terminalOutcome: FAILED; failures included Fourfold outcome mismatch details

scenarios.title: Cross-Host Transfer Cryptographic Identity Invariance
scenarios.setup: Bundle serialized to JSON string, transferred across process boundary, ingested by separate gateway
scenarios.attackerCapability: Serialization and network transit reproduction
scenarios.expected: Canonical JSON identity and signature verification invariant across host boundaries
scenarios.observed: Status ACCEPTED; identical bundleId computed; 2-of-3 threshold verified on foreign host

scenarios.title: Content Identity vs Logical Execution Identity Gap
scenarios.setup: Two distinct exports of the same runId with differing exportedAt timestamps ingested into archive
scenarios.attackerCapability: Multiple conflicting bundles claiming the same runId identity
scenarios.expected: Both bundles accepted into content archive under differing bundleIds; collision not detected at runId level
scenarios.observed: Both bundles ACCEPTED and stored as separate bundleId files; runId uniqueness is NOT enforced by content archive

scenarios.title: Two-Authority Collusion Boundary
scenarios.setup: Attacker compromises both Worker and Supervisor keys and signs synthetic bundle
scenarios.attackerCapability: 2-of-3 threshold satisfied by colluding compromised authorities
scenarios.expected: Gateway accepts bundle mathematically (threshold met) if internal replay invariants hold
scenarios.observed: Accepted by gateway; demonstrates theoretical boundary of 2-of-3 threshold against 2 compromised keys

scenarios.title: Keyring Trust Root Boundary
scenarios.setup: Host running ingestion gateway has rogue public key injected into TrustedKeyring
scenarios.attackerCapability: Local trust root compromise
scenarios.expected: Gateway validates signatures against rogue key because trust root was tampered
scenarios.observed: Gateway accepts rogue signatures; confirms security boundary relies on trusted keyring integrity

scenarios.title: Secret Leakage in Multi-Authority Evidence
scenarios.setup: Bundle contains unredacted API key in unhashed action inputPayload
scenarios.attackerCapability: Unredacted credential leakage in signed evidence payload
scenarios.expected: Gateway detects unredacted secret, quarantines bundle with UNREDACTED_SECRETS_CONTAINED
scenarios.observed: Quarantined with UNREDACTED_SECRETS_CONTAINED; raw payload quarantined without archive acceptance

scenarios.title: Post-Acceptance Local Tamper-Evidence
scenarios.setup: Bundle accepted into archive/accepted/, then on-disk JSON file is maliciously modified
scenarios.attackerCapability: Post-ingestion storage corruption or tampering
scenarios.expected: archive.verifyArchivedBundle returns valid: false and flags content hash mismatch
scenarios.observed: verifyArchivedBundle returned valid: false and hashMismatch: true

scenarios.title: Archive Retrieval Offline Determinism
scenarios.setup: Accepted bundle retrieved from archive on cold start with no active runtime
scenarios.attackerCapability: Cold audit retrieval
scenarios.expected: Retrieved bundle matches original canonical payload and passes offline replay verification
scenarios.observed: Retrieved bundle successfully; offline replay verification returned valid: true

scenarios.title: Idempotent Multi-Ingestion Across Restarts
scenarios.setup: Identical valid bundle ingested twice, including simulated gateway process restart
scenarios.attackerCapability: Duplicate delivery / replay of identical bundle
scenarios.expected: First ingestion ACCEPTED; second ingestion ALREADY_ARCHIVED; no duplicate files created
scenarios.observed: Second ingestion returned ALREADY_ARCHIVED; archive preserved content identity without duplicate writes

scenarios.title: Quarantine Reason Explainability
scenarios.setup: Multiple bundles rejected across distinct failure modes (secret, invalid id, invalid sig, under-threshold)
scenarios.attackerCapability: Varied attack payloads
scenarios.expected: Every quarantined bundle stores specific, machine-parseable reason codes in quarantine manifest
scenarios.observed: Quarantine manifests correctly logged exact reason codes and raw payloads for forensic inspection

scenarios.title: High-Throughput Multi-Authority Ingestion
scenarios.setup: 50 multi-authority bundles ingested consecutively through gateway pipeline
scenarios.attackerCapability: Burst load of evidence ingestion
scenarios.expected: All 50 bundles accepted and archived with 100% integrity and zero memory/state corruption
scenarios.observed: 50/50 bundles accepted; archive verified all 50 bundles; total elapsed time ~220ms
